about: What the original TempleOS V5.03 does with every formula of cartesian-corpus.json at every sample, evaluated as ::/Demo/Graphics/Cartesian.HC evaluates its input (ExePrint("ToF64(%s);",st) with the F64 globals x, y, y_last).
